name: Default
shortDescription: Web-based database diagram editor that imports a schema from a single query and exports SQL, served as a static app with diagrams kept in the browser.

alerts.message: Diagrams are stored in each browser's IndexedDB storage, not on the server. Export them to keep them across browsers and devices.

AI-powered SQL export is optional and needs OPENAI_API_KEY, or OPENAI_API_ENDPOINT plus LLM_MODEL_NAME for a custom OpenAI-compatible server. The values are served to every visitor in /config.js, so only set a key on an instance you do not expose publicly.
